test_function_signatures: test pybind11 function signature docstrings for kw_func0 through kw_func_udl_z and KWClass methods
test_named_arguments: test pybind11 named keyword argument passing to C++ bound functions kw_func1 through kw_func_udl_z
test_arg_and_kwargs: test pybind11 variadic args and kwargs forwarding via args_function and args_kwargs_function
test_mixed_args_and_kwargs: test pybind11 mixed positional args, variadic args, and kwargs with defaults via mixed_plus_args_kwargs_defaults
test_args_refcount: test pybind11 reference counting correctness for py::args elements combined with regular arguments
